description: Paradym is the easiest way to issue, verify, and manage verifiable credentials. This plugin manages wallets, SD-JWT VC credential templates and trusted entities, creates OpenID4VC issuance offers and verification requests, batch-revokes issued credentials, and manages webhook subscriptions with delivery history.
